blurb: Felton Music Hall brings an unrivaled live music experience to the Santa Cruz mountains. Music lovers of all genres can see both the best local talent or their favorite touring musicians while enjoying fresh craft food and drinks served in-house. Our restaurant is open Wednesday through Sunday 4-9PM.
